svg.title: PostDetailFeat wiring with CommentsState and dumb children
svg.desc: Smart parent PostDetailFeat provides CommentsState, injects PostState and CurrentUser, owns an editingId signal. It calls add/edit/remove on CommentsState and reads list, loading, error signals. It binds inputs and outputs of CommentEditorUi and CommentUi.
